subject: reasoning
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

A sits third to the left of X. Only one person sits between X and C when counted from the left of C. Only two people sit between B and W when counted from the right of W. D is an immediate neighbour of B. Who sits third to the right of Y?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. A sits third to the left of X.

2. Only one person sits between X and C when counted from the left of C.
